handshake_pairs.rule: Per-lane FFE/DFE coefficient exchange until receiver-ready.

handshake_pairs.name: PCS lock
handshake_pairs.rule: Block lock then alignment-marker lock then FEC alignment.

handshake_pairs.name: MDIO Clause-45
handshake_pairs.rule: Address cycle then data cycle on the same DEVAD.

dependency_graph.common_rule: MAC -> RS (800GMII) -> PCS (encode + FEC + lane-distribute) -> PMA (bit-mux/retime) -> PMD (PAM4). Each lane carries an embedded clock; the PCS deskews/reorders via alignment markers.
dependency_graph.data_dependency: Frame TX requires PCS lock + FEC alignment on the far end; RX requires PMD symbol recovery -> PCS block/AM lock -> FEC decode -> MAC reassembly.

logical_signaling_levels.name: Active PAM4 lane
logical_signaling_levels.meaning: Continuous 4-level PAM4 symbols at 106.25 GBd carrying FEC-encoded PCS blocks.

logical_signaling_levels.name: PCS alignment marker
logical_signaling_levels.meaning: Periodic per-PCS-lane code group for receiver deskew/reorder.

logical_signaling_levels.name: Link-training frame
logical_signaling_levels.meaning: Electrical-lane FFE/DFE coefficient request/response during bring-up.

packet_types_summary.count: 10+ canonical EtherTypes; full IEEE EtherType registry has hundreds

ordering_rules.bit_order_within_byte: LSB-first on the MAC service interface; FCS appended MSB-byte-first (UNCHANGED from base 802.3).
ordering_rules.lane_order: PCS distributes blocks round-robin across PCS lanes; alignment markers let the receiver recover the original order regardless of physical-lane skew/reorder.
